name: js-lessons
description: Web-development. Educational materials for the JS course.

scripts.full: npm run sw-identity && npm run lessons && npm run icons-worker && npm run content-worker && npm run prod && npm run service-worker
scripts.check: npm run lessons:check && npm run blocks && npm run workers
scripts.content: npm run lessons && node content-worker/build-content.js && node service-worker/config-service-worker.js --versions
scripts.content-worker: node content-worker/build-content.js && cd content-worker && npm run prod
scripts.service-worker: node service-worker/config-service-worker.js --versions && cd service-worker && npm run prod
scripts.install:all: yarn install --frozen-lockfile && cd icons-worker && yarn install --frozen-lockfile && cd ../content-worker && yarn install --frozen-lockfile && cd ../service-worker && yarn install --frozen-lockfile
scripts.deploy: git subtree push --prefix public origin gh-pages
scripts.staging: git subtree push --prefix public staging gh-pages
